title: Strategist
description:
As a Brand Strategist , you play a vital role developing comprehensive brand and user experience strategies that align with user-centered design principles and enhance digital product applications and web experiences. Leveraging your expertise in market research, consumer trends, and brand positioning, you also collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that thoughtfully crafted strategies come to life in digital user experiences. Your ability to analyze data, identify insights, and craft compelling brand messaging contribute to our clients' success in delivering impactful digital solutions. At 500 Designs, you will also be leveraging AI tools to enhance brand ideation, streamlining workflows and enhancing team productivity.

What You Do:

Research and Analysis:

  • Build relationships with clients and stakeholders to deeply understand their pain points and vision
  • Conduct primary and secondary research (such as user interviews, persona analysis, customer journey mapping) to gain deep insights into consumer behaviour, market trends, and competitive landscapes.
  • Stay updated on consumer research, industry trends, and emerging market shifts to inform brand strategies.
  • Analyze research findings, data, and trends to uncover insights, challenges, and opportunities that shape holistic and effective brand strategies.

Brand Strategy Development:

  • Collaborate with the strategy team to develop brand messaging, positioning, and strategy that align with user-centered design principles, target audiences, and market analysis,
  • Present and articulate strategic thinking and engage with clients to get buy-in and understand feedback.
  • Collaborate with Design Directors to ensure seamless integration of brand strategies into visual identities, sitemap and user flows.
  • Collaborate with Copywriters to translate brand strategy into voice and tone

Collaboration with Stakeholders:

  • Collaborate with clients, project managers, designers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals and requirements.
  • Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather input, address concerns, and make informed decisions.
  • Maintain effective communication channels to keep stakeholders updated on project progress and strategy development.

Brand Content Strategy and Messaging:

  • Transform brand strategies into messaging pillars that resonate with the priority audiences.
  • Provide data-driven content strategies that increase user engagement and elevate digital experiences.
  • Collaborate and guide the Copy team to develop copy that resonate with the client's brand.
  • Adapt communication styles and channels to effectively reach and engage different stakeholders.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • Proven experience as a Brand Strategist, Marketing Strategist, or similar role.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize research findings and data into actionable insights.
  • Excellent presentation skills, with confidence presenting strategic recommendations to large groups and senior stakeholders.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities that drive effective brand strategies.

What’s In Store For You:

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a generous salary that recognizes your skills and contributions
  • Flexibility at its Finest: Embrace the freedom of a 100% remote work environment, giving you the autonomy to work where you're most productive
  • Rewards Galore: Benefit from enticing company incentives and rewards that celebrate your achievements
  • Profit-share : As a valued team member, you'll have the opportunity to partake in our profit-sharing plan
  • Health and Wellness: Rest easy with comprehensive health coverage through our Health Card
  • Workspace Upgrade : Enhance your home office with our workspace upgrade allowance
  • Monthly Internet Upgrade Incentive : Enjoy monthly internet upgrade incentives to keep you connected at top speeds
  • Empowerment through Resources: Access a plethora of training resources, including design tools, to bolster your skill set
  • Engage and Grow: Participate in a variety of engaging internal and external company events, such as culture-building activities and enriching workshops
  • Free Lunch every Monday (a.k.a. Monchdays) : Kickstart your week with complimentary lunch every Monday
  • Recharge and Relax: Take advantage of paid vacation and sick leaves to ensure a healthy work-life balance
  • Work-Life integration : We foster a culture that values your overall well-being, allowing you to seamlessly integrate work and life

About 500 Designs

Join the team of passionate problem solvers at 500 Designs, the award-winning design agency based in sunny Irvine, California. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S., we're looking for talented individuals to help us tackle new challenges with wonder and curiosity.

Our 100+ person team specializes in strategy, branding, UI/UX, web design, creative, and development, providing clients with top-notch solutions that make a real impact. From crafting comprehensive brand strategies to designing stunning websites, we're committed to delivering innovative and high-quality work that helps our clients thrive.

At 500 Designs, we're not just a workplace – we're a community of talented individuals who are dedicated to growing, learning, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. If you're a passionate problem solver who's looking for an exciting and fulfilling career in the design industry, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and help shape the future of design.

title: Gerente Jr de Qualidade Comercial
description:
Company Overview

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

Team Overview

Você fará parte do recém-criado time de Qualidade Comercial, como colaborador individual, dentro da nossa estrutura de Enablement Comercial na 99Food, uma operação comprometida em escalar vendas de campo de alta performance com as habilidades, consistência e impacto adequados. Sua missão é atuar como o “guardião da qualidade”, monitorando tudo o que pode dar errado na operação de vendas — desde a execução de habilidades até o uso de sistemas e a aderência a processos — garantindo diagnóstico e correção rápidos. Este papel combina observação em campo, auditoria orientada por dados e feedback estratégico, impulsionando ações imediatas e melhorias de longo prazo no nosso motor de vendas.

Role Responsibilities

  • Projetar, implementar e liderar um framework abrangente de Qualidade de Vendas, incluindo auditorias aprofundadas, scorecards (técnicos, comportamentais, de processo e de uso de sistemas) e mecanismos estruturados de feedback.
  • Conduzir auditorias ao longo de toda a jornada comercial, observando visitas em campo, registros em CRM/sistemas, demonstrações, e-mails e aderência a playbooks, para identificar desvios e oportunidades.
  • Gerenciar, junto ao time, visitas frequentes em campo ao lado de Business Developers para observar a execução em tempo real, avaliar necessidades de coaching e validar o comportamento real versus o documentado.
  • Analisar padrões de uso em CRMs e outras ferramentas comerciais para detectar lacunas, subutilização ou uso indevido, retroalimentando insights para treinamentos, base de conhecimento (KB) e melhorias de processo.
  • Atuar como guardião da excelência: monitorar a conformidade com playbooks, fluxos de processo, base de conhecimento e uso de ferramentas, garantindo alinhamento em cada interação dos BDs.
  • Colaborar com os times de Sales Enablement, Produto, Operações e Tecnologia para traduzir achados de QA em melhorias, aprimorando a base de conhecimento, módulos de treinamento, fluxos de trabalho e sistemas.
  • Produzir relatórios recorrentes com insights de QA, lacunas emergentes, tendências e recomendações priorizadas para ações corretivas rápidas e evolução estratégica.
  • Orientar e desenvolver Especialistas de QA, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua, consistência e execução de qualidade baseada em dados.
  • Defender melhorias operacionais, de processo e sistêmicas com uma mentalidade orientada por hipóteses e forte alinhamento com princípios mais amplos de Controle de Qualidade.

Role Qualifications

  • Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em gestão da qualidade, auditoria de processos ou QA de vendas, especialmente em vendas de campo, tecnologia ou ambientes em escala.
  • Capacidade comprovada de desenhar frameworks robustos de QA, incluindo scorecards, matrizes de performance, rotinas de auditoria e fluxos de escalonamento.
  • Alta capacidade analítica: transformar dados quantitativos (CRM, métricas, dashboards) e observações qualitativas (campo, demos) em insights acionáveis.
  • Experiência com plataformas de CRM, monitoramento de uso de sistemas e compreensão de como sistemas impactam o comportamento comercial.
  • Perfil “mão na massa” e presença em campo: conforto para realizar visitas, avaliações presenciais e trabalhar próximo aos times operacionais.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação, com assertividade para apontar lacunas operacionais e colaborar entre áreas para resolvê-las.
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua, com resultados comprovados na transformação de insights de qualidade em ações práticas (treinamentos, atualizações de KB, refinamentos de processos/sistemas).
  • Certificações como Six Sigma/Black Belt ou experiência em Enablement são diferenciais

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.
  • Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.
  • Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.
  • Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.
  • Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.
  • Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso.
  • Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

Essa é a nossa jornada já escrita que ainda tem muito caminho para percorrer.

description:
Senior Procurement Manager

Department: Finance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Procurement Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 is responsible for leading and owning the procurement function for the tournament, with a strong focus on strategic influence, stakeholder management, and governance in a complex, very dynamic, and highly scrutinized environment.

In addition to delivering the full scope of procurement activities, including all operational aspects, the role acts as a senior business partner to leadership and project owners, proactively shaping procurement approaches, interpreting and adapting FIFA procurement policies to local and operational realities where justified, and driving alignment across functions.

The role requires senior judgment, credibility, negotiation skills, and authority to manage competing interests, challenge non‑compliant behavior, and resolve escalated or sensitive procurement matters, while ensuring transparency, integrity, and value for money across all procurement activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Partner Rights Delivery Manager

Department: Partnerships & Media

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team in Zurich and Brazil and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Head of Commercial Partnerships, the Partner Rights Delivery Manager supports the operational implementation and fulfillment of FIFA Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations. This role includes coordination of official sites requirements, stadiums preparations, and the delivery of Commercial Partners activities and related deliverables.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the planning and execution of the operational implementation and delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Commercial Partners agreements.
  • Implement and coordinate all commercial operations in line with the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • Support the implementation of all commercial/sponsorship activations and commercial rights programmes of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Collaborate with the Stadium Venue Managers, Stadium Authorities, and relevant Functional Areas to ensure delivery of the contractual rights and obligations of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.

  • Act as an operational point of contact for Commercial Partners in the host country for commercial delivery matters, supporting issue resolution and expectation management throughout the event delivery process.
  • Work with PRD suppliers and assist them in the delivery of their obligations.
  • Support the planning and delivery of all Partnership Rights Delivery related spaces, facilities and flows in the stadiums (and other official sites) as per defined stadium requirements under the guidance of the FIFA PRD project lead.

  • Assume administrative responsibility for the Partnership Rights Delivery team and provide support as required.

YOUR PROFILE

title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description:
About Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times a year in person in interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

Technology Focus

This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology – from the kernel through userspace. Apply if you are an exceptional Go, Rust or C/C++ engineer and want to work on next‑generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage. Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure are essential for modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro‑service architecture, or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects underway at Canonical:

  • RustVMM – a new hypervisor for Linux focused on performance, security and operability.
  • Rockcraft – an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
  • LXD – a modern system container and virtual machine manager used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms, covering low‑level kernel work, filesystems, VMMs, networking, and higher‑level REST API and CLI.
  • Kubernetes (MicroK8s & Charmed Kubernetes) – building on‑rail K8s, Charmed Kubernetes, and operations tooling.
  • OpenStack (Charmed OpenStack, OVN/OVS, Ceph) – delivering cloud platform technologies to large‑scale computing environments.

These teams hire system‑level C/C++, Go, Rust and Python developers to work on security‑critical, performance‑critical and mission‑critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management.

Location

We have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.

What You Will Focus On

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach.
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise.
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth.
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product.
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team.
  • Write high‑quality code to create new features.
  • Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them.
  • Review code produced by other engineers.
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions.

What We Are Looking For in You

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path.
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations.
  • Experience working on open‑source virtualisation or container technology.
  • Experience working in the kernel or very low‑level system.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments.
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events up to two weeks each.

Additional Skills We Value

  • Performance engineering and security experience.

What We Offer You

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About The Team

The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function.

About The Role

As a Lead IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high‑impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment.

You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.
  • Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations.
  • Owning the end-to-end ITSM toolchain (Jira Service Management or equivalent): configuration, workflow design, form logic, SLA rules, and integrations with adjacent systems.
  • Identifying and closing automation gaps — routing, escalation, notifications, and reporting — partnering with engineering teams to reduce manual toil across operations.
  • Defining and tracking operational KPIs (MTTR, SLA compliance, first-contact resolution, change success rate) and building regular reporting cadences for leadership and stakeholders.
  • Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows.
  • Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential in a regulated financial environment.
  • Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline.
  • Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function.
  • Hands‑on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end-to-end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it.

What We Offer

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kafka Specialist)
description:
Job Description

Who we are

Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative, but work well within a team.

Job Purpose

We are building the Common Data Backbone (CDB)—Fugro’s strategic data platform, which enables discovery, governance, and integration across our global geospatial data ecosystem. The CDB connects multiple cloud services and end-user applications through Apache Kafka, serving as the integration solution within the CDB for event orchestration and integration services.

To further develop and deploy our CDB, we want to strengthen the team with an experienced Kafka DevOps Engineer who will expand and mature the Kafka infrastructure on AWS. This role focuses on secure cluster setup, lifecycle management, performance tuning, Dev-Ops and reliability engineering to ensure Kafka runs at enterprise-grade standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain secure, highly available Kafka clusters in AWS (MSK or self-managed).
  • Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and proactive scaling.
  • Automate infrastructure and configuration using Terraform and GitOps principles.
  • Implement observability: metrics, Grafana dashboards, CloudWatch alarms.
  • Develop runbooks for incident response, disaster recovery, and rolling upgrades.
  • Ensure compliance with security and audit requirements (ISO27001).
  • Collaborate with development teams to provide Kafka best practices for .NET microservices and Databricks streaming jobs.
  • Conduct resilience testing and maintain documented RPO/RTO strategies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in cost optimization, reliability, and operational maturity.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5-6 years in DevOps/SRE roles, with 4 years hands-on Kafka operations at scale.
  • Strong knowledge of Kafka internals: partitions, replication, ISR, controller quorum, KRaft.
  • Expertise in AWS services: VPC, EC2, MSK, IAM, Secrets Manager, networking.
  • Proven experience with TLS/mTLS, SASL/SCRAM, ACLs, and secure cluster design. Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for cluster and topic configuration.

  • Assegurar conformidade com os padrões de Workplace Transport (Safety program), atuando como referência no site e promovendo a melhoria contínua dos níveis de segurança.

Por que VOCÊ?

  • Formação superior em Logística, Engenharia, Administração, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em operações de almoxarifado, depósito ou centros de distribuição, preferencialmente em ambientes de médio a grande porte;

  • Vivência ou exposição a ambientes com forte foco em segurança operacional e gestão de riscos;

Nosso compromisso é humanizar as relações, respeitando à individualidade e garantindo que cada colaborador sinta-se valorizado, incluído e parte essencial de nossa comunidade.

title: Python Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general track role, hiring for every team at Canonical who works in Python, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you believe you are already an outstanding Python engineer.

Canonical works across the entire open source spectrum. Canonical Ubuntu is well‑known as a developer favourite and enterprise‑friendly Linux. Our web services and system utilities are often written in Python, which we choose where collaboration with other teams, ecosystems and communities is more important than raw performance.

We hire Python Developers with a passion for open‑source software, innovation, and cutting‑edge technologies. We also look for colleagues who understand that a great product is more than code – it is ready for the unexpected, it is well documented, it is comprehensively tested, it is tastefully presented in its CLI or GUI. At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions through high‑quality, idiomatic Python code.

Your team will own a product that may comprise several codebases. These may be intended to run on servers, or on Kubernetes, or on the desktop, or as web services for Ubuntu clients. They may be utilities or frameworks or tools, or part of our production process.

Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open‑source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.

Location: we have remote Python engineering roles in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Write high‑quality, well‑designed and well‑tested Python software
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Display technical leadership at Canonical and in our communities
  • Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation with the aim to make it the best of its kind
  • Work from home with global travel twice a year for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above‑and‑beyond expectations
  • Well‑organised, self‑starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience writing thoroughly designed, modern, maintainable Python
  • Conscientiousness and detail orientation, with a focus on performance
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross‑compilation
  • Additional languages, particularly Golang or Rust, C or C++
  • Deep quality and test engineering
  • Web or Flutter front‑end experience
  • REST and gRPC API experience
  • SQL and NoSQL data store expertise
  • Experience with public clouds or OpenStack
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu packaging
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Procurement Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 is responsible for leading and owning the procurement function for the tournament, with a strong focus on strategic influence, stakeholder management, and governance in a complex, very dynamic, and highly scrutinized environment. In addition to delivering the full scope of procurement activities, including all operational aspects of it, the role acts as a senior business partner to leadership and project owners, proactively shaping procurement approaches, interpreting and adapting FIFA procurement policies to local and operational realities where justified, and driving alignment across functions. The role requires senior judgment, credibility, negotiation skills, and authority to manage competing interests, challenge non‑compliant behavior, and resolve escalated or sensitive procurement matters, while ensuring transparency, integrity, and value for money across all procurement activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing governance of the FIFA27 Procurement Policy, exercising senior judgment to contextualise policy application to local operational realities if needed, while safeguarding principles of efficiency, integrity and competition.
  • Ensure procurement processes are fit‑for‑purpose, proportionate, and risk‑based, balancing governance with operational speed and effectiveness.
  • Act as the senior procurement authority for FIFA27, providing clear direction, guidance, and challenge to project leaders, senior stakeholders, and functional heads.
  • Proactively influence senior internal stakeholders to embed procurement best practices and ensure early engagement in procurement planning.
  • Lead, support and mentor the FIFA27 Procurement team.
  • Serve as the primary interface between FIFA27 and FIFA HQ, ensuring alignment while representing FIFA27’s specific operational needs.
  • Contribute to the set‑up, maturity, and continuous improvement of the procurement function for the tournament.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Junior Graphic designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments.

You will support the creative development of Brand assets, ensuring consistent, world-class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives.

This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Purpose of the Role: This role combines world class graphic design excellence, strong project management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in the realm of sports and entertainment. This role reports to the Global head of Brand, marketing & promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines. Experience in Graphic Design in brand development context is mandatory.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Supports creative process from concept to execution across channels ensuring high-quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Designs & produces creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develop key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital-first creative assets.
  • Ensure strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards, while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic Design experience in the context of Brand creation and brand assets and collaterals.
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High-level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands‑on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Skills

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.
  • Experienced in managing multiple concurrent projects under tight timelines, with consistent attention to detail and creative quality.
  • Familiar with rights management, usage permissions, and protection of brand and design IP.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven HANDS‑ON expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Experience working with large-scale brand projects, live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in graphic design roles within agency, entertainment, FMCG, or sports-related industries.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

O Fonoaudiólogo (a) é responsável por realizar avaliações, diagnósticos e intervenções em pacientes com distúrbios de comunicação, voz, audição e deglutição, atuando sob supervisão e contribuindo para a promoção da saúde e bem-estar dos pacientes. Acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes durante o tratamento, ajustando as intervenções conforme a resposta ao tratamento e documentando todas as atividades realizadas de forma detalhada e organizada.
Prestar orientações a pacientes, familiares e equipes de saúde sobre estratégias de comunicação, cuidados com a audição, higiene vocal e prevenção de distúrbios, promovendo a conscientização e o autocuidado.
Participar de reuniões multidisciplinares, contribuindo com informações clínicas relevantes para o planejamento e execução do tratamento, além de colaborar na elaboração de planos de cuidado integrados.
Realizar atividades de educação em saúde, promovendo ações de conscientização sobre a importância da saúde auditiva, vocal e de comunicação na comunidade e nos ambientes de trabalho.
Manter registros atualizados de prontuários, relatórios e demais documentos clínicos, garantindo a confidencialidade e o cumprimento das normas éticas e legais da profissão.
Participar de treinamentos, cursos e atualizações profissionais para aprimorar conhecimentos técnicos e metodológicos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados.
Auxiliar na organização e manutenção do espaço clínico, garantindo condições adequadas para a realização dos atendimentos e o bem-estar dos pacientes.
Colaborar com a equipe de saúde na implementação de programas de prevenção, triagem e promoção da saúde auditiva e da comunicação, atuando de forma proativa na comunidade.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
1. COMO É SER COORDENADOR(A) DE RH INTERNACIONAL?

Você será responsável por assegurar a coordenação tática e operacional da área de Recursos Humanos Internacional, garantindo organização, alinhamento, qualidade e consistência nos processos de recrutamento, preparação, administração de missões e suporte a profissionais móveis internacionais de MSF-Brasil, assegurando também que os processos sejam conduzidos de forma equitativa, acessível e livres de vieses, promovendo diversidade nos perfis mobilizados.

Além disso, irá atuar como principal ponto focal diário da operação e de resolução de problemas, apoiando a Direção na tradução das prioridades estratégicas em planos de execução, e promovendo a integração e fluidez do trabalho entre a equipe de RH Internacional e outras áreas da organização.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Conduzir a área com clareza de prioridades, ritmo operacional consistente e previsibilidade das entregas, equilibrando múltiplas demandas e assegurando uma gestão de desempenho estruturada, orientada ao desenvolvimento contínuo, inclusivo e equitativo da equipe;
  • Garantir a padronização, consistência e melhoria contínua dos processos da área, envolvendo a equipe em soluções práticas e colaborativas e assegurando a integridade e confiabilidade dos dados e informações-chave que sustentam decisões e fortalecem a eficiência operacional;
  • Fortalecer a articulação com os Diretórios Operacionais (ODs), demais seções parceiras e outras entidades de MSF para antecipar demandas e integrar melhores práticas, mantendo sempre um olhar crítico e mantendo sempre um olhar crítico sobre desigualdades estruturais, promovendo práticas equitativas nos processos e garantindo representatividade e inclusão nas decisões e relações de trabalho.

3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Articulação interseccional e com Diretórios Operacionais

  • Atuar como interlocutor operacional junto aos Diretórios Operacionais (ODs), representando a área em reuniões e grupos de trabalho, acompanhando as demandas de mobilização de profissionais para os projetos humanitários e compreensão de perfis solicitados, prazos e prioridades, contribuindo para o alinhamento de pessoas candidatas e da disponibilidade de perfis, em conformidade com as diretrizes da Direção de RH, garantindo, sempre que possível, a consideração de diversidade de perfis e contextos nos processos de mobilização;
  • Promover e incentivar práticas de gestão de carreiras inclusiva em articulação com os OCs, garantindo equidade na distribuição de oportunidades, feedbacks e desenvolvimento entre a equipe e profissionais móveis internacionais;
  • Manter comunicação regular com outras seções parceiras (Partner Sections – PS) e demais unidades de RH internacional do movimento, compartilhando informações relevantes sobre perfis e processos de mobilização, contribuindo para o alinhamento de práticas e para a troca de aprendizados aplicáveis ao contexto de MSF-Brasil;

Coordenação tática e organização do fluxo de trabalho da equipe

  • Coordenar o fluxo de atividades da área, organizando e distribuindo tarefas, realocando esforços conforme prioridades definidas na área, contribuindo para o bom andamento dos processos e objetivos estratégicos do departamento;
  • Monitorar entregas e prazos, garantindo previsibilidade, identificando barreiras e redistribuindo atividades quando necessário;
  • Liderar reuniões operacionais, assegurando alinhamento, comunicação eficiente e cooperação entre os membros da equipe e suas diferentes funções (recrutamento, gestão de carreira, administração de missões, suporte psicossocial etc.);

Ponto focal operacional e resolução de problemas

  • Atuar como referência na resolução de dúvidas, obstáculos e intercorrências relacionadas às atividades operacionais de RHI, contribuindo para a continuidade e o bom funcionamento dos processos da área;
  • Colaborar na identificação e encaminhamento de situações que demandem orientação da Direção, especialmente assuntos com impacto estratégico, riscos reputacionais, decisões sensíveis ou que envolvam redefinição de políticas/processos, considerando impactos diferenciados sobre grupos diversos e assegurando respostas sensíveis a contextos de vulnerabilidade;
  • Contribuir para o monitoramento do funcionamento dos processos da área e potenciais riscos operacionais, sinalizando a gestão quando necessário e propondo soluções ou ações preventivas;

Apoio na melhoria contínua das operações de RHI

title: Machinist Technician BRA
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip‑top shape.

Job overview and responsibilities

This position is responsible for the operation of machinery that performs machining in metallic structures. Planning, turning, drilling, and grinding are examples of machinery processes that are part of the work scope under the Machinery Technician responsibility.

  • Works on machinery workshop handling all machining process to support aircraft maintenance heavy check
  • Fabrication, grinding and repair of metal structures is part of the regular job accountabilities
  • Operate lathe machine and measure work pieces verifying dimensions using appropriate tools
  • Be familiar with boring, drilling, reaming, threading, and tapping operations
  • Detecting malfunctions, replacing worn tools, cleaning debris from machine
  • Report any faulty operation of equipment or defective materials to the area supervisor
  • Operate lifting devices for movement of materials and other equipment as needed
  • Be familiar with the preparation of tools for machining
  • Load feed mechanism by lifting stock into position
  • Maintain specifications by observing drilling, grooving, and cutting, including turning, facing, and threading
  • Responsible for keeping equipment and work area clean and orderly
  • Verify settings by measuring positions, first‑run parts, and sample work pieces
  • Professionalism, integrity and work ethic while possessing a visionary skill set that will successfully carry the team into the future.
  • Must comply with Brazilian Norm NR -12 training and certification

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • High school diploma or equivalent in Machining Operation technical course with emphasis in planning, turning, drilling, and grinding
  • Local driver’s license
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship
  • Previous NR-1
  • 3 years’ experience in aeronautical industry
  • Must have extensive knowledge of machinery operation with emphasis on the aeronautical industry
  • Must have experience operating lathe machine, milling machine, vertical and horizontal band saw, drill and treading machine, hydraulic press and oven operation for heat treatment
  • Mechanical problem‑solving ability and troubleshooting skills a must
  • Must be able to read a tape measure, verify dimensions, use a straightedge and other measuring devices
  • Have the knowledge of machine drawings, fit and tolerances
  • Must be able to operate lifting devices
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Brazil for any employer without sponsorship
  • Must be able to read and understand work instructions, drawings, technical manuals and standards in English.
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time‑limited visa status, will not be awarded.

Unless subject to a collective bargaining agreement in the country to which an employee is being transferred; the employee retains their original date of employment and company seniority in the new country. Upon transfer, the employee is removed from payroll and benefits in former country and appropriately placed in the salary range and payroll / benefits systems of the new country.

Human Resources will assist with the terms and conditions of employment in light of labor agreements, collective agreements, country work rules and labor laws. In the new country, the employee is reinstated using the same employee id, date of employment and company seniority dates.

  • Executar atividades de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais;

  • Possuir escuta ativa e sensível;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente;
  • Zelar pela sua segurança, controle de pertences de riscos (giletes, fio dental, removedor esmalte, esmaltes etc.);

  • Realizar mudança de decúbito em paciente acamado;
  • Auxiliar e incentivar na organização dos pertences e quarto dos pacientes;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e ordem dos materiais, de equipamentos e de dependências de unidades de saúde;

E aí, vem fazer moda responsável com a gente?

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

Advanced English;

Dessa forma, as equipes de captação de recursos são fundamentais para que essa atuação seja realizada, pois é através delas, que se vincula financeiramente novas pessoas a nossa causa.COMO É SER UMA PESSOA CAPTADORA DE RECURSOS EM MSF-BRASIL:Trabalhar com Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras é muito mais do que abordar pessoas nas ruas — é ser a ponte entre a organização e aquelas que tornam nosso trabalho possível: as pessoas doadoras.Diariamente, você estará 100% nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro e região metropolitana, abordando ativamente as pessoas para apresentar a missão de MSF e convidá-las a se tornarem doadoras. O trabalho envolve conversar diretamente com o público, explicar o impacto da organização, contornar objeções e garantir novas adesões. Cada abordagem é uma oportunidade de transformar um simples encontro em um ato concreto de apoio às emergências médicas ao redor do mundo.É um trabalho dinâmico, onde cada dia traz novos desafios e aprendizados. O ambiente é sempre coletivo, repleto de troca com a equipe, compartilhamento de experiências e muita energia. Para brilhar nessa função, é essencial gostar de interagir, ser uma pessoa resiliente, comunicativa, carismática e persistente. Afinal, cada novo doação conquistada representa um impacto real na vida de quem mais precisa.Se você busca um trabalho com propósito, movimento e desafios diários, essa vaga é para você!COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?- Captar novas pessoas doadoras mensais nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro (trabalho 100% externo), apresentando uma abordagem objetiva e segura, a fim de garantir o ingresso de recursos para MSF;
- Preservar a imagem deMSF, mantendo uma postura profissional em meio a situações desconfortantes, com intuito de demonstrar segurança e responsabilidade na atuação;
- Assegurar o cadastro correto das novas pessoas doadoras, preenchendo com atenção e precisão os dados, para garantir o correto ingresso no sistema;
- Manter-se atualizado sobre as questões que envolvem a Organização, buscando sempre informação junto aos gestores, assim como nas redes sociais, para maior esclarecimento na captação de novas pessoas doadores.Requisitos:O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?- Português fluente;
- Ensino médio completo ou cursando graduação;
- Pacote Office básico.OQUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?- Experiências com vendas, captação de recursos, telemarketing, atendimento ao público, terceiro setor.QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?- Gerenciamento de estresse pois controla reações ultra emotivas e responde com calma;
- Capacidade de negociação para comunicar aos outros os seus próprios objetivos e demandas;
- Iniciativa e inovaçãopara identificar oportunidades e problemas;
- Flexibilidade comportamental para adaptar comportamentos as necessidades da situação.Venha fazer parte da Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil!PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 30/06/2026RETORNO:Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno.Benefícios:Assistência médica, Assistência odontológica, Auxílio Educação, Gympass, Seguro de Vida, Vale-refeição, Vale-transporte

title: Diploma Em Gestão De Vendas
description: Este curso começará proporcionando uma visão geral de como a venda e as vendas influenciam nosso cotidiano. Você aprenderá as características de uma marca e será orientado sobre as diferenças entre vendas e marketing. Em seguida, conhecerá o que é necessário para ter sucesso em vendas, além de definir os diferentes tipos de canais e ambientes de venda. Você aprenderá o conceito de venda adaptativa, explorará a ética empresarial e o comportamento ético nas vendas, e identificará os elementos de uma comunicação empresarial eficaz. Depois, estudará os sete passos do processo de vendas. Receberá orientação sobre prospecção, aprenderá a identificar necessidades e oportunidades de venda, e como estabelecer objetivos SMART antes das chamadas. O curso também abordará a importância da primeira impressão, a força da abordagem inicial, e como fazer contato com seu potencial cliente. Você aprenderá a se preparar para uma apresentação de vendas eficaz. Por fim, saberá como lidar com diferentes tipos de objeções e como empreendedores vendem a si mesmos e suas ideias de negócio. Como as vendas possuem um papel fundamental em nosso cotidiano e economia, uma carreira em vendas será sempre demandada. Este Diploma em Gestão de Vendas será muito interessante para quem pensa em iniciar uma carreira no setor de vendas, além de ser útil para profissionais que já atuam nessa área e desejam aprimorar suas habilidades. Confira o curso hoje mesmo e, em poucas horas, adquira valiosas competências de venda para impulsionar sua carreira.

Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.- Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.- Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities;
everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on
